mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{prefix}, '%')

SELECT id, name FROM users
ORDER BY name ASC ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN #{item}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age >= 18 AND status <> 'blocked'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (name, email, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status})
INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), updated_at = NOW()
INSERT INTO users_archive (id, name) SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE status = 'archived'
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET version = version + 1 WHERE last_seen < #{cutoff}
UPDATE users u SET u.name = CONCAT(u.name, '_x') WHERE u.id IN (SELECT id FROM stale_users)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM users WHERE id IN #{item}
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM users GROUP BY status HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE status = 'pending'
SELECT id, CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 'active' WHEN status = 'P' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'other' END AS label FROM users
SELECT t.id, t.total FROM (SELECT id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders GROUP BY id) t
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM blocked_users)
SELECT * FROM users WHERE age < 100 AND note = 'it''s fine'
